title: Retail supply chains still waiting for AI-Powered shopping revolution
summary: Retail supply chains are yet to experience the disruption of AI-powered shopping, as consumer adoption remains in its early stages, according to retail logistics business Paxon

extraction.key_fact: 소매 공급망은 아직 AI 쇼핑으로 인한 변화를 겪지 않았다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: Retail supply chains are yet to experience the disruption of AI-powered shopping, as consumer adoption remains in its early stages, according to retail logistics business Paxon
